# origincloud_iam_service_account_key (Resource)

A key pair an `EXTERNAL` service account authenticates with. The platform keeps only its public key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization the service account key is in. Changing it replaces the service account key.
- `service_account` (String) The service account the service account key is in. Its `id`, the full resource name `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`. `organization` must be the one it is in. Changing it replaces the service account key.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) The algorithm the key signs with: `ES256`. One of `ES256`.
- `create_time` (String) When the key was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The full name of who created the key: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/serviceAgents/{service_agent}` for a platform service agent, or `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/services/{service}` for a change the platform made itself.
- `credentials_file` (String, Sensitive) The credentials file, in the response that created the key and never again: a JSON document to save as it is. It holds `type` (`service_account_key`), `name` (the key's full name), `service_account` (the service account's full name), `algorithm` (`ES256`), `private_key` (the private key in PEM, `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`) and `sts_endpoint` (`https://sts.origincloudapis.eu`, where its assertions are exchanged). The platform keeps no copy. Empty in every other response.
- `delete_time` (String) When the key was deleted; unset while it is active. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `id` (String) The service account key's full resource name, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}/keys/{key}`: what an argument that refers to the service account key takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `last_use_time` (String) When an assertion signed with the key was last exchanged; unset while none has been. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `name` (String) The key's resource name.
- `state` (String) Where the key is in its lifecycle. One of `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`.
